description.en: Adds a vision_read tool, a composer switch and a model picker that send an image file to a separate multimodal model and return only its text description, so a session whose model declares text-only input can still read images without switching models. Models are enumerated at runtime with ctx.llm.listModels; openai-completions and anthropic-messages request shapes are both supported.
description.zh: 提供 vision_read 工具、输入框旁开关与模型选择，把图片发给独立的多模态模型并只回传文字描述，使声明为纯文本输入的会话模型无需切换模型也能读图。模型经 ctx.llm.listModels 在运行时枚举，同时支持 openai-completions 与 anthropic-messages 两种请求格式。
